evidence_cards.content: If the TMC workstations or network server fails, resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North. evidence_cards.content: If FCU North or South fails: (FCU Controller failures or FCU-TSU communications failure) Loss of changeable messages signs and DCUs associated with the failed FCU. Alternate control at the non-failed FCU (North or South).

evidence_cards.content: If FCUs North and South both fail... Alternate control units: Direct control at DCUs 1-5, and CMS 1-12 control from CMS cabinets. The operator shall be able to connect a lap top computer at the DCUs and operate the devices or perform manual operation from the MCU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the escalation path and manual intervention required when redundant automated systems fail simultaneously.
